verdict.rationale: Stripe's docs mention only generic subscription 'analytics' (monitor performance, benchmark against peers) and revenue-recognition accounting automation, but never specifically describe MRR, churn, cohort retention, or LTV computation as first-class dashboards. A community account explicitly contradicts the analytics claim, stating a team moved off Stripe because 'analytics/easy plan mgmt ... is something stripe doesn't have' compared to Recurly. missing for 10: explicit MRR/churn/cohort/LTV dashboards, documentation of cohort retention or LTV calculation, independent confirmation that analytics meet founder-grade BI needs.
